spans.s:
--twenty-three in number. For the sake of creation the Supreme Being associates with कालशक्ति and makes these twenty-three principles active.
1: भा.

. २९.
Twenty-four also in number.
2: Br. III. १९. ६४.
Sometimes twenty-five.
3: Ib.
--a sage of the epoch of the thirteenth Manu. भा. VIII. १३. ३१; Vi.
(I)--(Pauleya) a sage of the Raucya epoch. Br.
(III)--a son of Sudaridra, an aged Brahmana of पाञ्चालदेश. M. २१. 3.
--the one truth which could not be attained even by the mind (Veda). वा. १०२. १२७.
--a treatise attributed to Kardama (Kapila). It treats of twenty-four principles and the twenty-fifth was काल. भा. III. २१. ३२; २६. ११-16.
